title: Model executor pressure before adding agents
description: Change arrival rate, aggregate executor time, agent slots, and burst size. The model shows steady utilization, burst backlog, and recovery time without pretending to benchmark a real Jenkins installation.

profiles.label: Steady team feedback
profiles.detail: Frequent, short validation with enough agent headroom for normal variation.

profiles.label: Morning commit surge
profiles.detail: The steady rate fits, but a concentrated arrival burst exposes queue recovery.

profiles.label: Release verification
profiles.detail: Longer work and a sharp release window push a small pool beyond steady capacity.
